name: StashView
description: Developer-focused storage inspector: localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, and IndexedDB — right in DevTools.

_permission_notes.storage: Required to persist user preferences (theme, split position) locally in the extension.
_permission_notes.cookies: Required to read/write/delete cookies for the inspected page via chrome.cookies API.
_permission_notes.activeTab: Required to identify the inspected tab's URL/origin for scoping cookie reads.
_permission_notes.scripting: Required to inject content scripts into the inspected page to read/write localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB, which are only accessible in the page's own origin context.
_permission_notes.host_permissions <all_urls>: Required because DevTools can open on any origin the developer is working on; the extension must be able to inject scripts and read cookies for arbitrary origins.
